verdict.rationale: Brex exposes broad APIs (Accounting, Budgets, Team, Payments, Expenses, Transactions, Webhooks) covering most core UI functions, and even documents an MCP server for AI-native access. However, there's no evidence of a complete parity guarantee, no public OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), and features like AI-powered expense automation, travel booking, and receipt matching shown in the UI aren't confirmed as API-accessible. missing for 10: published OpenAPI/schema confirming full coverage, explicit parity statement, API access to travel booking and AI-assistant features, independent verification of completeness.
